owner_question: Are we approving discovery, platform shortlist, workflow redesign, adviser review or AICS diagnostic scoping?
evidence_to_attach: Decision owner; expiry date; target clinic locations; service lines; excluded data types
unsafe_claim_boundary: No CQC, GDPR, DTAC, DSPT, procurement approval or vendor ranking claim
safe_next_step: Name the accountable clinic owner and decide whether a no-credentials review is useful

owner_question: Which missed calls, WhatsApp/form enquiries, appointment reminders, recalls, finance questions or report links lack an accountable owner?
evidence_to_attach: Synthetic or redacted ageing table; source-to-owner map; blocker reason; next safe action
unsafe_claim_boundary: No appointment growth, no-show reduction, revenue, savings or ROI claim
safe_next_step: Prepare a redacted owner queue without patient identifiers

owner_question: Which messages must be routed to qualified staff rather than automated reply or AI receptionist scripting?
evidence_to_attach: Stop-rule register; red-flag categories; clinical/adviser owner; allowed admin response boundary
unsafe_claim_boundary: No medical advice, clinical-safety proof or AI-accuracy claim
safe_next_step: Use the synthetic stop-rule register before drafting any automation script

owner_question: Which consent, privacy notice, processor/DPA, subprocessor, retention and data-minimisation questions need qualified review?
evidence_to_attach: Question owner; source document pointer; adviser-needed marker; unresolved risk note
unsafe_claim_boundary: No legal, privacy, security or GDPR compliance conclusion
safe_next_step: Route unanswered questions to qualified legal/privacy/security owners

owner_question: What belongs with practice-management software, patient engagement, AI receptionist, call centre, booking marketplace, agency, adviser or AICS owner-evidence review?
evidence_to_attach: Route fit/gap notes; integration assumptions; owner queue evidence; buyer constraints
unsafe_claim_boundary: No vendor superiority, replacement, partnership or top-ranked claim
safe_next_step: Compare route fit after evidence owners and stop rules are visible

owner_question: What can AICS review without credentials, live patient data, PMS login, call recordings or production exports?
evidence_to_attach: Redacted screenshots; synthetic sample rows; owner interviews; policy links; missing-evidence log
unsafe_claim_boundary: No promise that review delivers compliance, growth, savings, bookings or implementation success
safe_next_step: Request a scoped no-credentials diagnostic only after boundaries are agreed
